# Liyuk

> An independent writing and project archive about technology, products, leadership, research, and field notes. Chinese is the original language; every published article has an English translation under `/en/`.

## Primary sections

- [Writing](https://liyuk.com/writing/): essays and field notes.
- [Projects](https://liyuk.com/projects/): products, tools, and experiments.
- [Research](https://liyuk.com/research/): papers, research notes, and talks.
- [Photos](https://liyuk.com/photos/): curated photography and field notes.
- [Columns](https://liyuk.com/columns/): hand-curated reading paths.
- [English](https://liyuk.com/en/): the full site with English article bodies and an English UI.

## Machine-readable resources

- [RSS (中文)](https://liyuk.com/rss.xml)
- [RSS (English)](https://liyuk.com/en/rss.xml)
- [Sitemap](https://liyuk.com/sitemap-index.xml)
